author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 3.1: GAE Lambda Tuning (0.99)
abstract: This experiment concludes my PPO hyperparameter tuning. The baseline lambda of 0.97 scored 85.3, and my test of 0.95 scored 83.9. I will now test a higher lambda of 0.99 to map out the performance curve for this parameter.
